text:
sanjay: Heads-up team — EU midnight change window at 00:00 UTC. Freeze merges at -30m (23:30). We need a final readiness sweep and owners for canary, smoke, rollback. Ack and callouts pls.
rachael: Ack. I’ll own canary traffic shift and metrics.
mia: Ack — I’ll run the smoke suite and watch error budget.
jordan: On standby for rollback; I’ve prepared the rollback runbook and pin list.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Scheduled rollout: service=redwood-api, version=v3.4.1, mode=staged-canary, start=00:05 UTC, canary-interval=5m. Pin applied: v3.4.1 -> pinned to prod by release-manager.
sanjay: @jordan drop the rollback steps here (short) and confirm the database migration flag is off.
jordan: Rollback short: 1) Pause traffic shift (deploybot pause) 2) Re-pin to previous stable (v3.4.0) 3) Trigger deploybot rollback command 4) Verify healthcheck (200/200 civ) 5) Notify postmortem channel. DB migration flag: OFF (confirmed).
mia: Smoke checklist: - run smoke.sh (staging) - quick end-to-end chat flow - embeddings regression sample - latency smoke (p95 < 120ms). I’ll post results.
rachael: Canary plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 15m. If error rate > 1% absolute or latency p95 > +50ms for 2 consecutive windows, abort and rollback.
ops-oncall: Noted. I’m watching infra metrics, will escalate at first sign of regressions.
sanjay: Release notes snippet (for internal): "v3.4.1: latency optimizations on KV cache lookups; tokenization fix for legacy prompts; improved batch scheduling heuristics." Any customer-facing risk callouts?
rachael: No customer-facing breaking changes. Mention transient endpoint throttling during warmup.
jordan: Also call out that a small percent of traffic may hit fallback-model (cpu-variant) on first warm-up — included in notes.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary started: rollout_id=rl-202403-9, canary_target=1%, status=running. Logs: 
```
[00:06:12] canary: 50 reqs, errors=0, p95=98ms
[00:07:12] canary: 120 reqs, errors=0, p95=105ms
```
mia: Smoke run complete — all tests PASS, sample embedding cosine > 0.92 baseline, no obvious regressions.
rachael: Canary -> 5% now. Observing metrics.
ops-oncall: Infra alarms green. No node OOMs, GPU mem stable.
sanjay: Quick note: hold on any large config flips until 10m into roll.
jordan: If we rollback, I'll coordinate pin removal on the deploybot and open the incident channel.
rachael: Canary -> 20% complete. Latency p95 +8ms, errors steady.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Rollout progressing: 20% -> 100% scheduled in 30m if no abort.
sanjay: Two final asks: - who owns release notes publish (internal changelog + external banner)? - confirm post-rollout smoke window (30m).
rachael: I’ll publish internal changelog. Marketing will handle external banner (I pinged @marketing). Post-rollout smoke = 30m, agreed.
mia: Monitoring alert thresholds updated for this rollout (error rate 0.8% -> 1% abort).
ops-oncall: If abort triggered I’ll triage infra, Jordan does app rollback.
sanjay: Thanks. Everyone please add a :thumbsup: once you’ve set notifications and will be on watch. I’ll stay in this thread through the rollout.
rachael: +1 :thumbsup:
mia: +1 :thumbsup:
jordan: +1 :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: +1 :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary completed -> status=stable at 20%. Next step: schedule ramp to 100% in 15m.
sanjay: Great. If anything changes, call the rollback lane. Otherwise we’ll reconvene at +45m for post-rollout readout.
rachael: Copy that — will post final rollout notes and link to pinned runbook when done.
